title: Page 9
content_zh:
“真的！”一群女生你握我手、我牵你手，发出了羡慕的赞叹。

文景瑞儿子出生当天，白天各家媒体还给予祝福，下午却有某家电视台爆料，说文景瑞和妻子是契约婚姻，有效期限只到小孩生下为止，而神秘的文太太名叫温希琳，是一名父不详的私生女，还说她贪慕虚荣，为了钱出卖自己的身体和亲生小孩，是个拜金女，引发民众哗然。

而向来不爱接受媒体采访，对个人隐私保密到家的文景瑞听到这消息，为了维护自己妻子，他大动作召开记者会，澄清这项不实传言——

“我妻子的确父不详，但她的出身并未带给她任何负面影响，相反的，她是个好女人，是我所见过最善良、最单纯的好女人，绝非报导里所说的拜金女。”文景瑞语气诚恳的说。

“另外，我曾对外说过我是个白手起家的穷苦孩子，关于这一点，很抱歉我说了谎。我从小与母亲相依为命，直到我母亲病逝，才回到我父亲身边——我父亲就是三年前在美国车祸过世的文氏金控总经理，文渊华。”

此话一出，在座的记者们都惊讶的瞪大眼。

“我到父亲身边时，他已与我妻子的母亲温雅女士结婚，我与我妻子相识于幼时，一同生活三年，我照料她生活起居，她给予我信赖祟拜，我们不是亲兄妹，却比亲兄妹更为亲密，直到双方父母离婚，我们不得不分离。”

文景瑞出示了数张他们曾经一起拍的生活照，还大大方方的传阅下去，让所有在场人士验证照片并无作假。

“以现在科技发达，大家可以回去估狗，我与我妻子的家庭背景很容易就能查到，我父亲一共有三任妻子，其中并不包括我母亲——我必须说那是我父亲这辈子最大的损失。”他俏皮的眨眨眼，幽了亡父一默，引起在场媒体哄堂大笑。

“后来我只身到意大利，一待就是好多年，直到我回台湾，意外跟我妻子重逢，这中间我们完全失去联系，只能说这就是缘分吧。至于着急娶她是因为我无法再忍受失去和分离，不让我太太曝光则是因为我妻子性格单纯，我不希望我们的婚姻让她的生活受到影响。各位，我文景瑞在此严重否认所有对我妻子的不实指控，若再有任何诋毁我妻子名誉的言论，我将会寻求法律途径，替她讨回公道。”

他说得情真意切，可惜这些媒体也不是好糊弄的，并没有因此放过他。

“文先生，请你说明一下，温小姐同母异父的妹妹温希恩，她赴美就医的费用真的是你付的吗？你为什么要为一个十几年没见过的童年玩伴支付那么大笔的费用？”

文景瑞利眼扫过那名八卦杂志记者，神情严肃。“我妻子是个善良的女人，她深爱家人，愿意为所爱的人付出所有，而我亦然，当一个男人爱上一个女人时，什么都想给她，区区几百万对我来说根本不算什么，只要她快乐，我名下的一切都可以给她。

“没错，温希恩小姐赴美医治的费用的确由我买单，不过今年十四岁的温希恩小姐也告诉我，她将在三十岁之前连本带利还给我，我很期待我这位小姨子将来的成就，也请大家跟我一起期待。最后我要说，我妻子是个很棒的女人，而能够跟她结婚生子的我则是最幸福的男人，谢谢大家。”说完便离开了现场。

记者会结束后，文氏金控董事长文传鑫也发出声明稿，承认了文景瑞跟文家的关系，并大力赞赏温希琳这个孙媳妇，于此同时，前景建设董事长温祖雄同样公开表示自己这位外孙女的品行优良，表示是自己以前不会想才会忽略她，但从往后会好好疼惜她。

两大集团的董事长都联合称赞温希琳，让外界对她的印象趋于正面，更多群众则是把话题围绕在两人浪漫的爱情故事上头，至于契约、金钱，或者是婚姻关系的真假，已经没有人在乎了。

第10章(2)

听着身边的陌生人叽叽喳喳的讨论，同样在麦当劳里的石澄音味如嚼蜡地吃着薯条，她脸颊凹陷、神情狼狈，以往的骄傲完全没有了。

“好难吃……”她吃了两根薯条便皱起眉，再也吞不下去。

她从小到大都是到高级餐厅吃饭，从来没有到过快餐店，就连早餐也只吃星巴克，绝对不吃这种没有品味的东西。

但她现在只能吃得起这种东西。

因为爸妈带着家中仅剩的钱，丢下她走了。

她想起前两天爸爸匆匆忙忙回来收拾东西，边收边气急败坏的对她大吼大叫。

“刚才文景瑞来家里告诉我一个消息，原来前阵子前景建设被黑客入侵、我挪用公款、贿赂官员的证据，都是他让人挖出来爆给记者的，就因为你让温希琳吃闭门羹！你这个败家女，除了会买衣服乱花钱之外，你还会做什么？”石焕忠听到时差点没气死。

“你外公知道是你丢了温希琳的喜帖，让他没坐到主桌当主婚人后气得要命，还怪我不会教小孩！音音，你妈我从没有被你外公这样训过，都是因为你！”温柔也对女儿暴吼，一点也不温柔。

“还有，是你偷听了文景瑞的私事后爆料给记者对吧？他非常不高兴，所以故意针对我们家，他说知道我参与职棒签赌，这事明天一早就会爆出来，他来提醒我一声，说我只剩今晚能走人！石澄音，你怎么会这么白目？认不出文景瑞就算了，可琳琳都嫁给他了，你竟然还去招惹她，我们真是被你给害死了！我跟你妈要走了，你去找份工作养自己，以后各人造业各人担。”说完，夫妻俩头也不回走了。

想到这里，石澄音苦笑，爸妈就这样丢下她离开了，而丈夫因为坚持要离婚，跟那个怀了他小孩的小三共组家庭，早就搬离住处，更拒绝与她直接对话，只透过律师传话谈离婚条件。

“咯咯咯咯咯。”她突然发出可怕的笑声，看着自己不再纤细美丽的手指，表情茫然。

她真是蠢啊，想让别人过得比自己不幸，将别人狠狠踩在脚底，结果到头来呢？不幸的人只有自己，她后悔了，真的好后悔……

当温希琳产后出院，抱着儿子住进月子中心时，她感到非常疑惑，因为路人看见她时，老是露出像看见偶像般兴奋的眼神，而在月子中心里，那些护理人员居然争着要帮她照顾小孩，对她更是关怀备至。

“温小姐，你好好休息，宝宝饿了我们会喂，你完全不需要担心，只要好好把身子调理好就行了。”

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

到底发生什么事了？

温希琳很想把事情搞清楚，但她太累了，阵痛了十几个小时才生下孩子，让她觉得全身像被卡车辗过，也就没有去细想，每天就是吃和睡，舒舒服服的躺了一个星期。

“姊夫，这题数学这样解可以吗？”

“不错，懂得举一反三，还不会被陷阱迷惑，解得好。”

这天傍晚温希琳醒来，就看见下了课的妹妹以及下了班的文景瑞，两人感情诡异的好，坐在房间的矮几旁一对一教学，气氛十分融洽，像是他们之前根本没有吵过架，那只是她的幻觉。

经过一周的狂吃狂睡，温希琳的精神渐渐恢复，她翻个身想坐起来，那两个专心做功课的一大一小立刻丢下讲义，飞奔到她身边来。
content_en:
"Really!" A group of girls exclaimed in admiration as you held my hand and I held yours.

On the day Wen Jingrui's son was born, various media outlets gave blessings during the day. In the afternoon, a certain TV station broke the news, saying that Wen Jingrui and his wife were in a contract marriage, which was only valid until the child was born. The mysterious Mrs. Wen's name was Wen Xilin, an illegitimate daughter with an unknown father. They also said that she was greedy for vanity and sold her body and biological child for money. She was a gold digger, which caused an uproar among the public.

When Wen Jingrui, who never liked to be interviewed by the media and kept his personal privacy confidential, heard the news, in order to protect his wife, he held a press conference to clarify this false rumor——

"My wife's father is indeed unknown, but her origin has not brought any negative impact on her. On the contrary, she is a good woman, the kindest and most innocent good woman I have ever seen. She is definitely not the gold digger mentioned in the reports." Wen Jingrui said in a sincere tone.

"In addition, I have said to the public that I am a poor child who made his fortune from scratch. Regarding this point, I am sorry that I lied. I have been dependent on my mother since I was a child. It was not until my mother died of illness that I returned to my father - my father is Wen Yuanhua, the general manager of Wenshi Financial Holdings who passed away in a car accident in the United States three years ago."

As soon as these words came out, the reporters present all widened their eyes in surprise.

"When I came to my father's side, he was already married to my wife's mother, Ms. Wen Ya. My wife and I had known each other since we were young and lived together for three years. I took care of her daily life and she gave me her trust and respect. We were not biological brothers and sisters, but we were closer than biological brothers and sisters until our parents divorced and we had to separate."

Wen Jingrui showed several photos of their daily life that they had taken together and circulated them openly so that everyone present could verify that the photos were not fake.

"With today's advanced technology, you can go back and evaluate dogs. It's easy to check the family background of my wife and I. My father had three wives in total, not including my mother - I must say that was the biggest loss in my father's life." He winked playfully and silenced his late father, causing the media present to burst into laughter.

"Then I went to Italy alone and stayed there for many years until I returned to Taiwan and unexpectedly reunited with my wife. During this period, we completely lost contact. I can only say that this was fate. As for being anxious to marry her, it was because I could no longer bear the loss and separation, and it was because I wanted to prevent my wife from being exposed.Because my wife has a simple character, I don’t want our marriage to affect her life. Everyone, I, Wen Jingrui, seriously deny all false accusations against my wife.If there are any more remarks that slander my wife’s reputation, I will seek legal means to seek justice for her.”

He said it sincerely, but unfortunately the media were not easy to fool and did not let him go.

"Mr. Wen, please explain, did you really pay for Miss Wen's half-sister Wen Xi'en to go to the United States for medical treatment? Why did you pay such a large amount for a childhood playmate you haven't seen for more than ten years?"

Wen Jingruili glanced at the gossip magazine reporter with a serious expression."My wife is a kind woman. She loves her family deeply and is willing to give her all for the people she loves. I am the same. When a man falls in love with a woman, he wants to give her everything. A few million is nothing to me. As long as she is happy, I can give her everything in my name.

"Yes, I did pay for Miss Wen Xi'en's medical treatment in the United States. However, Miss Wen Xi'en, who is fourteen years old this year, also told me that she will return the money to me with interest before she is thirty years old. I am very much looking forward to the future achievements of my sister-in-law, and please everyone look forward to it with me.Finally, I want to say that my wife is a great woman, and I am the happiest man to be able to marry her and have children. Thank you all."After that, he left the scene.

After the press conference, Wen's Financial Holdings Chairman Wen Chuanxin also issued a statement, acknowledging Wen Jingrui's relationship with the Wen family, and strongly appreciated Wen Xilin's granddaughter-in-law. At the same time, Wen Zuxiong, chairman of Prospect Construction, also publicly stated that his granddaughter has good conduct, saying that he ignored her because he would not think about it before, but he will cherish her in the future.

The chairman of the two major groups jointly praised Wen Xilin, which made the outside world's impression of her more positive. More people focused on the romantic love story between the two. As for the contract, money, or the authenticity of the marriage, no one cared anymore.

Chapter 10(2)

Listening to the chattering discussions of the strangers around her, Shi Chengyin, who was also in McDonald's, was eating French fries with a heavy taste. Her cheeks were sunken, her expression was miserable, and her previous pride was completely gone.

"It tastes so bad..." She frowned after eating two fries and couldn't swallow any more.

She has always eaten at high-end restaurants since she was a child. She has never been to a fast food restaurant. She only eats Starbucks for breakfast and will never eat such tasteless food.

But this is all she can afford now.

Because her parents left her with the only money they had left in the family.

She remembered that her father came back in a hurry to pack things two days ago, and yelled at her angrily while doing so.

"Wen Jingrui came to my house just now to tell me the news. It turns out that the evidence that Prospect Construction was hacked by hackers a while ago and that I misappropriated public funds and bribed officials was all dug up and exposed to reporters by someone else, just because you rejected Wen Xilin!You, a prodigal girl, besides spending money on clothes, what else do you do?"Shi Huanzhong almost died of anger when he heard this.

"Your grandpa was furious when he found out that you lost Wen Xilin's wedding invitation and prevented him from sitting at the main table as the officiant. He also blamed me for not knowing how to teach children!Yinyin, your mother and I have never been trained like this by your grandpa, it’s all because of you!"Wen Wen also yelled at her daughter, not gentle at all.

"Also, it was you who eavesdropped on Wen Jingrui's personal affairs and then broke the news to reporters, right?He was very unhappy, so he deliberately targeted our family. He said that he knew that I was involved in professional baseball lottery betting, and this matter would be revealed early tomorrow morning. He came to remind me that I had only tonight to leave!Shi Chengyin, why are you so blank-eyed?It doesn't matter if you don't recognize Wen Jingrui, but Linlin is already married to him, and you still go to provoke her. We are really killed by you!Your mother and I are leaving. You find a job to support yourself. From now on, everyone will have their own business."After saying that, the couple left without looking back.

Thinking of this, Shi Chengyin smiled bitterly. Her parents just left her. Her husband insisted on getting a divorce and started a family with the mistress who was pregnant with his child. He had already moved out of the house and refused to talk to her directly. He only sent messages through a lawyer to discuss the divorce conditions.

“Kick-kick-kick."She suddenly let out a terrible laugh, looking at her fingers that were no longer slender and beautiful, with a blank expression.

She is so stupid. She wants others to be miserable than herself and tramples on others. What will happen in the end?The only unfortunate person is herself. She regrets it. She really regrets it...

When Wen Xilin was discharged from the hospital after giving birth and moved into the confinement center with her son in her arms, she was very confused because when passers-by saw her, they always showed excited eyes as if they were seeing an idol. However, in the confinement center, the nursing staff actually rushed to help her take care of the child and were even more caring about her.

"Ms. Wen, you have a good rest. We will feed the baby when he is hungry. You don't need to worry at all. Just take good care of yourself."

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

What happened?

Wen Xilin wanted to figure things out, but she was too tired. It took more than ten hours of labor pains to give birth to the baby, which made her feel like her whole body had been run over by a truck, so she didn't think about it in detail. She just ate and slept every day, and lay comfortably for a week.

“Brother-in-law, can this math problem be solved like this?"

“Yes, I know how to draw inferences from one instance, and I won’t be fooled by traps, so I can solve them well."

Wen Xilin woke up in the evening and saw her sister after class and Wen Jingrui after class. The two had a strange relationship. They were sitting on the short side of the room teaching one-on-one. The atmosphere was very harmonious, as if they had never quarreled before, it was just her imagination.

After a week of eating and sleeping, Wen Xilin's energy gradually recovered. She turned over and tried to sit up. The two men, one large and one small, who were concentrating on their homework immediately dropped their handouts and rushed to her side.
